test_name: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring - CA-2 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Audit-Lake-039
Primary NIST family: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring (CA); evidence focus: CA-2.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: one low-severity assessment finding has not yet been entered into the POA&M although an owner and due date are assigned. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
